snippet.title: Cleaner Company | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://mythwright.gg/CleanerCompany-YT

 Star Wipers, ready your mops! In an online co-op expedition for up to 4 players, use an arsenal of tools to clean up abandoned space stations, unexplored planets, and ruined restaurants across the cosmos. Start by tidying away the corpses of your predecessors.
